item.description: An independent investigation has found failings in urology at Townsville Hospital and Health Service could have been mitigated by the board years earlier.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: Macquarie faces $14m fine for savings rate failures
item.description: Macquarie Bank has admitted to failures in the promotion of its "welcome" interest rate for new savings account customers.

item.title: ABC News: Coral colony the size of three MCGs thriving off remote Australian island
item.description: An enormous rose coral colony, one of the largest ever recorded, is mapped by a team of researchers off the Cocos (Keeling) Islands.

item.title: ABC News: Gold Coast AFLW player delisted just weeks out from giving birth
item.description: The AFLW's pregnancy policy is called into question with a Suns player delisted just weeks out from giving birth.

item.title: ABC News: Legends urge Australia to 'move on' from Sandpapergate amid opposing claims
item.description: As Mitchell Starc and Usman Khawaja's recollections of the 2018 incident differ, Adam Gilchrist says Australia must move on.

item.title: ABC News: US charges three men over terror plots, including planned assault on UK airbase
item.description: Three men are charged by US authorities with plotting a "campaign of terror" of nearly 20 attacks targeting Jewish communities in Europe and the US and the British military base at RAF Fairford.

item.title: ABC News: Meghan Markle's father accused of cutting off ankle monitor
item.description: Thomas Markle has been taken into custody after allegedly cutting off his ankle monitor, which was a condition of his bail after being charged over child sexual abuse material.

item.title: ABC News: Review finds Bendigo hospital did not follow procedure for brain deaths
item.description: A review of deaths at Bendigo Health's intensive care unit finds a patient's relative felt "hurried" and "pressured" to decide about organ donation, with four cases raising significant concerns.

item.title: ABC News: Police offer $1m reward to find father suspected murdered by organised crime
item.description: NSW Police said when the family called his mobile phone on the night of his disappearance, they believed they could hear a man screaming before the call ended.

item.title: ABC News: Sinner targeting Australian Open return after earlier 'impossible goal'
item.description: The two-time champion at Melbourne Park has no plans to miss out next year after having his 2026 season cruelled by injury.
